# Self-test for unique_jobs
def test_unique_jobs_basic():
    # Test that same row appears only once
    rows = [
        {'source': 'A', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'test'},
        {'source': 'A', 'source_id': '2', 'title': 'different'},
        {'source': 'A', 'source_id': '1', 'title': 'same'},  # Should be deduped
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 results, got {len(result)}"
    assert result[0]['source'] == 'A'
    assert result[0]['source_id'] == '1'
    assert result[1]['source'] == 'A'
    assert result[1]['source_id'] == '2'

def test_unique_jobs_no_duplicate_source():
    # Test deduplication by (source, source_id)
    rows = [
        {'source': 'A', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'source': 'B', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'source': 'A', 'source_id': '2'},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 3

def test_unique_jobs_missing_source():
    # Test with missing source - keep separately
    rows = [
        {'source': 'A', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'source': None, 'source_id': '2'},
        {'source': '', 'source_id': ''},  # empty strings are different from None
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 3

def test_unique_jobs_stability_order():
    # First occurrence wins - maintain order
    rows = [
        {'source': 'A', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'source': 'B', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'source': 'A', 'source_id': '1'},  # duplicate of first
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2
    assert result[0]['source'] == 'A'
    assert result[1]['source'] == 'B'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_unique_jobs_basic()
    print("test_unique_jobs_basic passed")
    
    test_unique_jobs_no_duplicate_source()
    print("test_unique_jobs_no_duplicate_source passed")
    
    test_unique_jobs_missing_source()
    print("test_unique_jobs_missing_source passed")
    
    test_unique_jobs_stability_order()
    print("test_unique_jobs_stability_order passed")
    
    print("All tests passed!")

            result.append(row)
